audience: small makers who track materials, stock and production runs in Craftybase

useCases.title: Find materials below their reorder level
useCases.text: List materials with their stock on hand, available stock and reorder level. Open one material for its unit and unit cost.

useCases.title: Trace the stock history of one material
useCases.text: Read the stock history of one material, oldest first. Read a long history in month windows.

useCases.title: Review manufacture runs for a product
useCases.text: List the products. Then list the manufacture runs of one product and open a run for its line items.

useCases.title: Check recipe costs and supplier purchases
useCases.text: List recipes with their ingredients and calculated costs. Cost fields appear only if the key's user can view financials. List purchases with line items and suppliers.

useCases.title: Audit stock changes across the account
useCases.text: List the inventory adjustments of materials and components for a date window. Filter by reason to see manual changes and stocktakes.
